Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Node `sre-lab-worker2` (cluster-scoped, no namespace) is NotReady because its kubelet stopped posting node status and renewing its heartbeat Lease, so the node controller set Ready, MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure to Unknown and applied the unreachable taints.

EVIDENCE:
1. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe node sre-lab-worker2`: Ready is `Unknown`, reason `NodeStatusUnknown`, message "Kubelet stopped posting node status.", last heartbeat 12:13:49 and transition 12:19:27 (+01:00). The three pressure conditions show the same reason, so the kubelet is silent rather than reporting a resource problem.
2. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe node sre-lab-worker2`: Taints are `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute` and `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoSchedule`.
3. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get lease sre-lab-worker2 -n kube-node-lease -o yaml`: `spec.renewTime: "2026-11-01T11:18:36.176005Z"` (12:18:36 +01:00) with `leaseDurationSeconds: 40`, so the heartbeat is stale.
4. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe node sre-lab-worker2`: the only Node event is `NodeNotReady` from `node-controller` ("Node sre-lab-worker2 status is now: NodeNotReady", x2 over 65m). No kubelet-side warning appears in the node's events.
5. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get pods -A -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=sre-lab-worker2` (diag-k8s): the node still lists cert-manager x3, kube-system `kindnet-88psw` and `kube-proxy-74ls5`, and `shop/catalog-6b8cf764b7-xvrnl` at 0/1 `ImagePullBackOff`. The kube-system and cert-manager pods show `1 (3h11m ago)` restarts, which predates this outage and is not conclusive on its own.
6. Not established: why the kubelet stopped. Its logs (`journalctl -u kubelet`) are not reachable with the allowed kubectl verbs.

FIX (not applied): on the host, inspect the kubelet inside the sre-lab-worker2 kind node container (`systemctl status kubelet`, `journalctl -u kubelet --since "-1h"`), then restart the kubelet there once its failure is understood.

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: the kubelet stopped: `Kubelet stopped posting node status` (every condition `Unknown`), not memory, disk or PID pressure

Fact.Name: side effect
Fact.Value: taint `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable`; its pods are marked not ready

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: restart the kubelet on the host (`systemctl start kubelet`); cordon the node meanwhile
